## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Busselton, Australia. It starts at 12 Ludlow Park Road.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Have you ever ridden a BMX and a skateboard up in the treetops? Now's your chance with these tickets to Forest Adventures Park Entry. With two and a half hours to play with you can not only experience a treetop BMX ride - something you can't do anywhere else in Australia - you can also play like little monkeys across six huge courses combining rope and wire challenges.
>
> This amazing adventure park spans eight acres of unspoiled natural bushland. With over 500 five-star reviews on Facebook and Google combined, make sure you put this on your 'things to do' list when you're visiting the Margaret River Region.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €39.79. It was rated 5.0 out of 5 from 4 ratings and 1 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
